bibl.title: Ptolemy's Savior God, "Saving the Phenomena" and Plato's Timaeus.
bibl.seg: Cristian Tolsa, Ptolemy's Savior God, "Saving the Phenomena" and Plato's Timaeus.
bibl.note: Addresses the motivations for the dedication of Claudius Ptolemy's Canobic inscription to the "savior god". - 1. To "save the phenomena". - 2. The savior god in the Timaeus. - 3. Two senses of divine salvation in the Timaeus and in the inscription. - 4. Conclusion.
